summary: This is a Markdown document that serves as a landing page for article series on a blog. It imports and displays various components like statistics, translation coverage information, and a set of cards that showcase the available series, along with some introductory text explaining what readers will find.

explanations.3: This tells the documentation or blogging system not to generate a table of contents automatically for this page, probably because the page structure doesn't need one.
explanations.5: This specifies that 'christophe' is the author of this page, so the system knows who wrote it.
explanations.8: This imports custom CSS styling rules from a file so the components on this page display with the intended look and feel.
explanations.10: This is an instruction to the Markdown linter to ignore a specific formatting rule for the rest of the file—in this case, the rule about heading hierarchy.
explanations.20: This comment explains a quirk: the statistics component counts only translated articles when viewing the French version, which might mislead readers about the blog's actual size.
